decisions.reason: As a core multi-model safety shoe line that has remained in the range after launch, it is likely to be retained unless a replacement generation quickly supersedes it.
The comfort insole still fits the footwear ecosystem, but among the insole offers it is the most exposed to SKU rationalization if management wants to simplify overlapping accessories.
The supportive insole has a clearer functional role in cross-selling with work shoes, though overlap within the insole range still creates some consolidation risk.
The ergonomic safety shoe series appears strategically important in the firm's main category and remains unlikely to be withdrawn so soon after launch.
Because the moulded insole was positioned as a flagship direction for the firm, management would be very unlikely to remove it absent a major product strategy change.
